    Data: U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard (Title IV students only). Earnings are medians, so state values of "mean school" treat each school equally and "enrollment-weighted" favours big schools. Missing codes (PrivacySuppressed, NULL) are left out, so some variables cover fewer schools.
